name: Pi Review - Minimal open-source terminal coding agent focused on extensibility, tree-structured sessions, and shell-native repo workflows.
description: Pi is Mario Zechner's open-source terminal coding agent for developers who want a coding harness they can bend to their workflow instead of another locked IDE shell. The official docs emphasize extensibility through TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, packages, SDK, and ...
